products.title: Echo Vase
products.description: A sculptural vase in pale ceramic. The cutout highlights its geometric silhouette. Style it with dried branches or arrangements.

products.title: Terra Vase
products.description: Vertical ridges in a warm terracotta shade. The narrow neck frames a single statement stem.

products.title: Olive Vase
products.description: Two rounded forms in translucent olive glass. In sunlight, the vase casts a tinted shadow.

products.title: Wave Vase
products.description: An asymmetrical vase with soft curves. Its matte, textured finish looks different in side light and diffuse light.

products.title: Marble Vase
products.description: A rounded vase with a short neck and natural flecks. Its compact size fits a shelf or bedside table.

products.title: Amber Vase
products.description: Warm amber glass with softly curved facets. The silhouette shifts with the viewing angle, and the wide neck holds a bouquet.
